meta.basis: El Hiloush, Principles of Maps, via 'Cartography Knowledge Graph and AI Agent Skills' (user-supplied PDF, 2026-10-23). Design rules marked synthesis in that guide are applied as standard GIS practice.
meta.one_line_classification: Small-scale interactive thematic history map of Sudan and its neighbours, qualitative categories (polity control, groups, settlement roles), time-scrubbed across 68 eras, web screen 390 px to desktop.

six_declarations.datum: WGS 84; all layers stored in EPSG:4326 (Wikidata P625, Pleiades, OpenHistoricalMap, Natural Earth are WGS 84). No datum transformation applied; none needed.

projection_display.default: EPSG:3857 Web Mercator (conformal; preserves local shape and direction). At Sudan's latitudes (~3-23°N) area inflation is ~0.1-17%, uneven north-south.
projection_display.area_comparison: Equal-area option: Lambert Azimuthal Equal-Area centred 30°E 15°N (proj string '+proj=laea +lat_0=15 +lon_0=30 +datum=WGS84 +units=m'). Use for any 'which polity was bigger' view and for all area numbers. Mercator must never be used for area comparison.
projection_display.disclosure_en: Web Mercator display: shapes are true locally, areas are not comparable; switch to equal-area to compare sizes.
projection_display.disclosure_ar: عرض ميركاتور للويب: الأشكال صحيحة محلياً لكن المساحات غير قابلة للمقارنة؛ استخدم الإسقاط متساوي المساحة للمقارنة.

six_declarations.scale: Small scale (smaller than 1:500,000 at all usable zooms). Positions are anchor points and generalised extents: never use for measurement claims. Distances/areas, if shown, computed in the LAEA CRS in metres, never in degrees.
six_declarations.vintage: Per layer: each era's extent/city/group record carries its source_ids and the dataset build date (2026-10-24). Modern population: UN WUP 2025 revision (MODEL).
six_declarations.classification: Qualitative only: distinct hues/shapes for categories; no ordered ramps. Population (if shown) as proportional symbols of totals, never choropleth of raw counts.
six_declarations.height_reference: Terrain basemap heights are orthometric (above mean sea level) as published by the basemap provider; no ellipsoidal heights shown.

palette_note: Polity fills use a qualitative, colour-vision-safe set (Okabe-Ito hues) assigned per polity id; checked to survive greyscale by pairing every hue with a distinct dash/shape.

symbol_classes.edge: feathered 6px inner glow, no hard edge

symbol_classes.note: Abyei, Kafia Kingi, Ilemi, Halaib, Bir Tawil. Never filled as a polygon owned by either state.

symbol_classes.edge: radial fade, no outline: limits not given by sources

symbol_classes.label_en: Town (attested, no role in this era)
symbol_classes.label_ar: بلدة (موثقة، دون دور في هذه الحقبة)

symbol_classes.note: Reserved: in current data visible_to = last role end, so ruins disappear rather than show as ruins.
appears only in the legend list panel
hillshade never alone: pair with tint key in metres above sea level; source must be PD/CC0/CC BY (e.g. Natural Earth raster, PD)

APPROXIMATE.rule: dashed outline [4,3], halve fill opacity, feathered edge

CONTESTED.rule: amber hatch + dashed line; points only for the 5 disputed areas; tooltip lists both claims

SINGLE-SOURCE.rule: small '1' superscript glyph on label; popup states single source

VERIFY.rule: hollow symbol + '?' glyph; excluded from social exports

FIRST-ATTESTED.rule: symbol appears with a left-open fade-in tick on the time slider: place is older than its first mention

RUIN-UNDATED.rule: symbol fades out over the last role's end; no hard end tick

MODEL.rule: value in grey italics with 'model' tag; proportional circle with dashed rim

REPORTED.rule: open triangle; popup names reporting body

gis_furniture.scale_bar: metric (km) + imperial toggle; recomputed for latitude of map centre (Mercator scale varies by latitude); hide numeric RF on web
gis_furniture.graticule: 5° lines, labelled at frame edge, 0.5px #999 at 50%; toggle; densify lines so they curve correctly in LAEA
gis_furniture.north_arrow: shown only in LAEA mode (north not uniformly up away from centre); omitted in Web Mercator where north is up
gis_furniture.credit_line: Datum WGS 84 · Display EPSG:3857 (or LAEA 30°E 15°N) · Data: OpenHistoricalMap (CC0), Wikidata (CC0), Pleiades (CC BY 3.0), Natural Earth (PD), UN WUP 2025 (CC BY 3.0 IGO) · cited sources per feature · build 2026-10-24
gis_furniture.info_panel: metadata panel stating the six declarations (interactive equivalent of marginalia)
